# Mathilde De Luca

> Author, speaker and artist exploring what it means to be human. Her work explores the
> invisible structures that shape us — the roles we inherit, the stories we repeat, the fears
> we call intuition, the identities we build to be loved, accepted, or safe — at the
> intersection of psychology, philosophy, lived experience and ancient wisdom.

## Book

- [self as a universe](https://mathildedeluca.com/self-as-a-universe.html): a collection of poetry and
  reflections where the personal becomes universal. ISBN 9798199299367. Buy on
  [Amazon](https://a.co/d/0fFWXzAd). The page includes several poems from the book
  ("unbelief", "peeling", "learning", "to the sea").

## Fragments

- [Fragments](https://mathildedeluca.com/fragments.html): unpublished pieces of writing, in
  different forms.

## Essays & newsletter

- [Inner Exploration (Substack)](https://mathildedeluca.substack.com/): essays on the invisible
  structures that shape us.
- [Essays index](https://mathildedeluca.com/essays.html)

## Podcast

- [Inner Exploration (podcast)](https://mathildedeluca.substack.com/podcast): conversations and
  guided immersions on consciousness, conditioning, freedom and identity. Also on
  [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/0341kXHlxtj29iFHy69TCA) and
  [Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/inner-exploration-the-podcast/id6797916473).

## Events

- Book readings, philosophy talks, writing workshops, 1:1 sessions, and Maison Amour Collective
  (creative gatherings: art & jam, writers' dinners, ecstatic dance). Details:
  [mathildedeluca.com/#events](https://mathildedeluca.com/#events)
